propositions: Local git call sites (`compact.py`, `delete.py`, `fsck.py`, `txn.py`, `event_append.py`, `metrics/blame.py`, `metrics/git_metrics.py`) are unbounded with no contention policy under high concurrent local agent use.
Concurrent local rebar sessions contend on shared git locks (index.lock, ref locks) and currently surface errors to agents instead of absorbing them automatically.

Per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry/backoff with tens-of-seconds default budget must serialize local git operations and resolve transient conflicts silently, with one actionable error only on stuck locks.
Transient lock conflicts (index.lock or ref locks briefly held by competing processes) must self-heal via retried signatures (index.lock, cannot lock ref pattern) with no error surfaced.
Each local git call site must be bounded with watchdog timeouts (120s for plumbing, 300s for metrics) justified against local latency, not copied from network values.
Uncontended store git writes must add zero latency with non-blocking advisory-lock fast path and no sleep on happy path.
